source.checkpoint: SW0097 seed1 frozen source, evaluated with SW0143 T selective-geodesic operator

readout.energy: SW0162 full-N signed pair energy from production Q, native A tuple[0], and learned gain
readout.candidate: merge only 4-neighbor foreground groups; sum all cross-pair energy including negative evidence; retain every source-T foreground patch; stop when no positive eligible merge remains
readout.background: exact source-T QCC background; foreground labels assigned by first row-major patch

evaluation.ground_truth: native128 masks converted by the registered modal 4x4 contract, opened only after all candidate/control/Source-T/Slot predictions validate
evaluation.expansion_gate: candidate FG-ARI mean > Source-T, paired 95% CI lower > 0, per-image foreground IoU exactly equals Source-T, matched-object-IoU mean >= Source-T
